d: GTA 6 has yet to launch, but the hype is already translating into big numbers. With the game scheduled for November 19, 2026, console sales are rising, millions are watching its previews, and fans are preparing to spend up to $100 on premium editions. Estimates suggest GTA 6 could generate between $3.3 billion and $5.2 billion in sales by the end of launch week. But the frenzy could come at a cost, too.
